frame: 438 HOLD_FOR_LATER_REVIEW units with historical LLM ONE_WORK
limitations: A document with multiple pagination segments need not contain multiple conceptual works.
A With: note may refer to later library binding instead of publisher-issued composite.
A subtitle with and/or punctuation often describes one work.
An Edition table_of_contents may describe chapters, not independent works.
Tiers prioritize further checking; they are not estimates of identity-error probability.
No defined prompt must never be treated as an automatic merge authorization.
Case 11-13 were known before these exploratory rules were designed; sensitivity is not independent validation.
Selection only covers 438 historical held ONE_WORK units, not the full OL corpus.
Underlying workshop-derived Edition tables were marked LOCAL_VALIDATION_NOT_PUBLISHED.
No human labels, source entities, Project W identities, or earlier screening releases were changed.

triage_definition.T1_CONTENT_CLUE: Notes indicating another bound item or collection/adaptation, OR same Edition has multi-Arabic pagination and a non-empty subtitle
triage_definition.T2_SCOPE_OR_PAGINATION: Explicit collection, volume or dramatic title wording, OR multi-Arabic pagination without same-Edition subtitle
triage_definition.T3_GENERAL_METADATA_VARIATION: Other v1 title/author variation or v2 review prompt (including contents presence or subtitle separators)
triage_definition.T4_NO_DEFINED_PROMPT: Neither screen generated a prompt; NEVER evidence of safe merger
triage_definition.ranking_input: v1 and v2 bibliographic signals only; no held-out reviewer decisions, historical LLM confidence, or prior approval outcomes
